gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed World Health Organization (WHO) grade 4 glioma (GBM) or gliosarcoma, IDH wild-type, per WHO 2021 classification

candidate_evidence.quote: Phase I Trial of DNA-PK Inhibitor (PEPOSERTIB ) in Combination With Radiation and Adjuvant Temozolomide in Newly Diagnosed MGMT Unmethylated and Recurrent Glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly Diagnosed MGMT Unmethylated and Recurrent Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Ability of the investigational drug to cross the blood brain barrier will be tested by measuring concentration of the drug within the blood and the resected brain tumor tissue.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: This will be correlated with biomarkers of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) damage in brain tumor tissue, blood, and hair follicle.
To determine the ability of Peposertib to cross the blood brain barrier and to evaluate their pharmacodynamic properties in resected tissue. (Stage II)

role_evidence.quote: Peposertib may further stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth.
This is a dose-escalation study of Peposertib.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: DNA-dependent protein kinase (DNA-PK) inhibition with radiation

role_evidence.quote: ADJUVANT: Patients receive temozolomide PO QD on days 1-5. Treatment repeats every 28 days for up to 6 cycles in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

source_quote.quote: Histologically confirmed World Health Organization (WHO) grade 4 glioma (GBM) or gliosarcoma, IDH wild-type, per WHO 2021 classification
Documentation of MGMT unmethylated GBM per testing at any Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendment (CLIA) certified laboratory

biomarkers.biomarker_other: DNA damage biomarkers (DNA-PK inhibition pharmacodynamics) in tumour, blood and hair follicle

source_quote.quote: This will be correlated with biomarkers of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) damage in brain tumor tissue, blood, and hair follicle.

coder_notes: MGMT unmethylated status is required only for the newly diagnosed cohort (recurrent cohort has no MGMT requirement); cohorts are not separate registered arms, so coded enrichment with empty arms. Bevacizumab is permitted at physician discretion in recurrent Stage IIC/D adjuvant phase (eligibility text only, not a registered intervention), not listed. Tumour immune microenvironment alterations after DNA-PK inhibition are an additional correlative outcome.
